summary: Full-stack test of Minimize-Any-Card + Hot Focus features. All acceptance criteria pass: 8 per-card minimize buttons (min-btn-*) collapse to strips (min-strip-*) with headline stats (min-stat-*); localStorage persistence verified across reload for wallet & pl (both minimized and expanded states); minimize-all-btn collapses all 8 cards (strips=8); expand-all-btn restores them (strips=0) without console errors; Bot Control hot-focus-section has all 9 fields (mode-select, cooldown, reserve, lower-lows, weak-bounce-s/pct, stagnant-s/range, breakdown); UI Save Config flow round-trips through PUT /api/bot/config (mode=pause, cooldown=120, breakdown=35 verified via GET, then restored to slow/90/40). GET /api/rh/status returns paper.focus/hot_dropped/hot_board (all empty as expected on paused bot). GET /api/reentry/watchlist → 200. Backend regression: pytest tests/test_rh_paper.py test_rh_dex.py test_rh_discovery.py test_reentry_logic.py → 48 passed.

issues: One benign 401 fetch during initial pre-cookie load (auth check race before session cookie applied). Does not affect functionality.

critical_code_review_comments: Sections (section-bot-control, etc.) do not expose data-open state; minimize-all/expand-all functionality verified via strip counts and lack of console errors, but future automated regression would benefit from a data-open attribute on CollapsibleSection root.
